No observations are published. See docs/source-audit/real-gdp-per-capita.md.

series.title: Population
series.definition: Permanent resident population at 31 December in persons. Published historical estimates through 1980, followed by annual population statistics.
series.aggregation: Published 31 December population, not annual average or 1 January.

breaks.description: Census-based historical estimates give way to ESPOP annual population statistics.
STATPOP register-based population statistics replace ESPOP; population-definition and production changes around the 2010 census.

series.usage_notes: 1861–1980 census-based population estimates are reconstructed. 1981–2010 ESPOP; from 2011 STATPOP. Register-based census and permanent-resident definition changed around 2010/2011. Preserve these transitions; 2026 is absent. Counts may change in later vintages.

series.title: Real GDP
series.definition: Output measured in volumes; preserve price basis and reconstruction methodology.
series.aggregation: Annual unadjusted GDP volumes; reference year 2020. Source reuse grant pending.
series.usage_notes: Candidate. Audit on 8 October 2026: Establish a dataset-specific redistribution grant for the annual real-volume workbook, or obtain a compatible FSO OPEN-BY real-volume dataset. No observations are published. See docs/source-audit/real-gdp.md.

series.title: Real GDP growth
series.definition: Annual real change in GDP at prices of the preceding year, published by FSO. Distinct from nominal GDP change.
series.aggregation: Published annual percentage change; no derivation from nominal GDP.

breaks.description: Transition from reconstructed historical national accounts to the current framework; full history is not methodologically uniform.

series.usage_notes: 1949–1994 reconstructed historical accounts. The 1995 transition changes methodology. 1948 is explicitly missing in the source; 1946–1948 and 2026 have no value. Normal source status A is final in this retained vintage; later vintages can revise history.

series.aggregation: Native national monthly rate; exact seasonality, denominator and history pending audit.
series.source_identifier: AMSTAT / national total / registered unemployment rate / monthly selection pending
series.usage_notes: Candidate. Audit on 8 October 2026: Obtain an auditable national SECO/FSO monthly rate export, its denominator and method history, and a dataset-specific public redistribution grant. No observations are published. See docs/source-audit/registered-unemployment.md.

series.title: ILO unemployment
series.definition: Quarterly total ILO unemployment rate in percent of the survey labour force, as published by FSO. Survey estimates are observed statistics.
series.aggregation: Published quarterly averages; Q2 only in 1991–2009. No interpolation for the missing historical quarters.

breaks.description: Diplomats and international officials were included through 2008; subsequent survey population differs.
Continuous quarterly SLFS replaces the historical annual Q2 survey. Revised weighting introduces a 2009/2010 boundary.
Changes to the SLFS survey in 2021 create a documented comparability boundary.

series.usage_notes: Preserve gaps before 2010. This is the ILO survey concept, distinct from registered unemployment. Final denotes this retained published vintage, not immunity from later revisions. Native quarterly data are available in the catalogue and downloads.

series.title: Consumer price index
series.definition: Published monthly total Swiss consumer price index, December 2025 = 100, basket structure 2025.
series.aggregation: Native monthly total index levels as published; no annualisation.
series.usage_notes: Available from December 1982 through September 2026. Historical levels are restated on the December 2025 base; do not splice older index bases. Preserve historical gaps. Annual inflation is a separate published measure. Final denotes this retained vintage and does not prohibit later revisions.

series.title: Annual CPI inflation
series.definition: Published percentage change between annual-average total CPI levels. December-on-December inflation is a distinct measure.
series.aggregation: Published VAR_y-1 annual-average inflation, preserving the source precision; no derivation from rounded monthly indices.
series.usage_notes: 1984–2025 complete-year published changes. Negative values and zero are valid. 2026 is incomplete and absent. History may change in subsequent vintages.

series.title: SNB policy rate
series.definition: SNB policy rate in percent at its introduction and subsequent effective rate changes, extracted from the official daily LZ series.
series.aggregation: First observed effective rate and each changed value; unchanged business-day repetitions are compressed. These are effective dates, not announcement dates.

breaks.description: SNB policy rate introduced; replaces the earlier three-month Libor target range.

series.usage_notes: 12 effective-date observations, 13 June 2019–20 June 2025. The retained official daily source continues through 2 October 2026 with rate 0. No earlier instrument is spliced into this line. Event-frequency data are in the catalogue/downloads. Annual calendar-day averages are a separate series.

series.title: Historical SNB instruments
series.definition: Structural catalogue entry for historical SNB instruments published as separate discount, Lombard and Libor target-bound series.
series.instrument: Instrument-specific series listed in usage notes
series.aggregation: Do not splice discount rates, Libor target ranges and policy rates.
series.usage_notes: Structural catalogue placeholder. Verified historical instruments are published separately as snb-discount-rate, snb-lombard-rate, snb-libor-target-lower and snb-libor-target-upper. Their instrument changes and differing frequencies prevent a blended historical policy-rate series; this placeholder intentionally has no observations.

series.title: Nominal GDP
series.definition: Annual Swiss gross domestic product at current prices, in CHF millions. The FSO long series covers 1948–2025; 1948–1994 values are retropolated reconstructions. This measure preserves price changes as well as output changes.

series.definition: Calendar-day-weighted annual mean of the administered SNB policy rate, calculated from official effective daily rates for complete years.
